name: Pear "Nachos" with Greek Yogurt, Pumpkin Seeds, Cranberries & Honey
instructions: Place yogurt in a small bowl, add water, and whisk until smooth. Set aside.
Wash, dry, quarter, and core pears; slice lengthwise into thin wedges.
Divide pear wedges between plates. Top with yogurt, pumpkin seeds, and cranberries.
To serve, drizzle pear "nachos" with honey and enjoy!
author: Mealime
